subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Haunted Wasteland, dropping down a small stone structure leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In the Haunted Wasteland there is a...small stone structure and when you...drop down it, you'll find this Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the back of a tree beside the dry fountain just before reaching the Spirit Temple at night.

evidence.quote: Just before you reach the Spirit Temple,...beside the dry fountain, on the back...of one of the trees, check at night.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping bugs into the Magic Bean hole in front of the Spirit Temple reveals a Gold Skulltula before planting a Magic Bean.

evidence.quote: Before planting the Magic Bean in the...hole in front of the Spirit Temple,...drop a bunch of bugs into it first.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Riding the grown Magic Bean at night at the Spirit Temple reveals a Gold Skulltula along the way.

evidence.quote: After planting the Magic Bean at the...Spirit Temple, ride it along at night...and you'll find this along the way.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Spirit Temple as Young Link, a Gold Skulltula crawls on the back of a climbable wall and can be retrieved with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: In the Spirit Temple as Young Link this...one is crawling around on the back of a...climbable wall, get it with Boomerang.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At the top of a climbable wall in the Spirit Temple, turning around allows Link to throw the Boomerang at a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: At the top of a climbable wall in the...Spirit Temple, turn around and throw...your Boomerang at this Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Spirit Temple as Young Link, turning around at the top of a staircase reveals a Gold Skulltula above the door.

evidence.quote: There is a staircase to go up as Young...Link and when you turn around you will...see a Gold Skulltula above the door.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Spirit Temple as an adult, a Gold Skulltula is found behind a blue block that is moved by playing the Song of Time.

evidence.quote: You will find this one behind a blue...block in the Spirit Temple as an adult,...move the block by playing Song of Time.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At the top of the large room in the Spirit Temple as an adult, playing Scarecrow's Song allows Link to Longshot to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: At the top of the large room in the...Spirit Temple as adult, play scarecrow's...song and Longshot to this Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At Zora's Fountain, using the Silver Gauntlets to lift the rock near the cave reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: After the Spirit Temple head for Zora's...Fountain and use the Silver Gauntlets...to lift the rock near the cave.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Zora's Domain as Adult Link, a Gold Skulltula is located on the left at the end of the top waterfall path.

evidence.quote: Enter Zora's Domain as Adult Link and...at the end of the top of the waterfall...path, look on your left to see this one.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: On Death Mountain Trail at night, a Gold Skulltula is located in the rocky area just before the climbable wall at the top.

evidence.quote: On the Death Mountain Trail this one...is found at night in the rocky area...just before the climable wall at the top.

subject: Adult's Wallet
text: Acquiring 10 or more Gold Skulltula tokens rewards Link with an Adult's Wallet in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: After acquiring 10 or more Gold Skulltula...tokens, head to Kakariko Village to be...rewarded with an ADULT'S WALLET.

subject: Stone of Agony
text: Acquiring 20 or more Gold Skulltula tokens rewards Link with a Stone of Agony in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: After acquiring 20 or more Gold Skulltula...tokens, head to Kakariko Village to be...rewarded with a STONE OF AGONY.

subject: Giant's Wallet
text: Acquiring 30 or more Gold Skulltula tokens rewards Link with a Giant's Wallet in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: After acquiring 30 or more Gold Skulltula...tokens, head to Kakariko Village to be...rewarded with a GIANT'S WALLET.

subject: Bombchu
text: Acquiring 40 or more Gold Skulltula tokens rewards Link with a Bombchu in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: After acquiring 40 or more Gold Skulltula...tokens, head to Kakariko Village to be...rewarded with a BOMBCHU.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Acquiring 50 or more Gold Skulltula tokens rewards Link with a Piece of Heart in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: After acquiring 50 or more Gold Skulltula...tokens, head to Kakariko Village to be...rewarded with a PIECE OF HEART [021].

subject: Huge Rupee
text: Acquiring 100 or more Skulltula tokens rewards Link with a respawning Huge Rupee in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: After acquiring 100 or more Skulltula...tokens, head to Kakariko Village to be...rewarded with a respawning HUGE RUPEE.

subject: Magic Bean Hole
text: A Magic Bean hole is located in Zora's River near the start, right beside the man who sells magic beans.

evidence.quote: In Zora's River, you will find this one...right beside the fat guy who sells you...the magic beans, just near the start.

subject: Magic Bean Hole
text: In Gerudo Valley, gliding down off the edge with a Cucco leads to a Magic Bean hole at the bottom.

evidence.quote: In Gerudo Valley, glide down off the edge...with a Cucco above you head and find...this hole down at the very bottom.

subject: Magic Bean Hole
text: Entering the Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest and taking an immediate left leads to a Magic Bean hole.

evidence.quote: Enter The Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest...and make an immediate left, this path...will soon lead you to a bean hole.

subject: Magic Bean Hole
text: In the Lost Woods, following the directions right, left, right, left, and left leads to a hole in the ground to plant a Magic Bean.

evidence.quote: In The Lost Woods go right, left, right,...left, left and here you will find a hole...in the ground.  Plant a Magic Bean there.

subject: Magic Bean Hole
text: A Magic Bean hole is located in Kokiri Forest just to the side of the shop.

evidence.quote: The hole is located in Kokiri Forest,...make your way over to the shop and you...will find it just to the side.

subject: Magic Bean Hole
text: In Kakariko Village, a Magic Bean hole is located at the northwest corner of the graveyard.

evidence.quote: In Kakariko Village, the graveyard to...be more specific you will find this...hole up at the northwest corner.

subject: Magic Bean Hole
text: A Magic Bean hole is located on Death Mountain Trail right in front of Dodongo's Cavern beside the Goron.

evidence.quote: This one is located on the Death Mountain...Trail right in front of the Dodongo's...Cavern, on the ground beside the Goron.

subject: Magic Bean Hole
text: A Magic Bean hole is located in Lake Hylia on the ground beside the house on the west shore by the bridge.

evidence.quote: There is one located in Lake Hylia on...the ground beside the house on the...west side of the shore, at the bridge.

subject: Magic Bean Hole
text: After learning the Bolero of Fire, Link can warp to a Magic Bean hole on Death Mountain.

evidence.quote: Once you have learned the Bolero of...Fire you can use it to warp to this...Magic Bean hole on the Death Mountain.

subject: Magic Bean Hole
text: A Magic Bean hole is located in front of the Spirit Temple, accessible by returning as Young Link after reaching it as an adult.

evidence.quote: The final hole is not found until you...reach the Spirit Temple as an adult,...come back as Young Link, it's in front.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears outside Hyrule Castle Town by heading south from the gate past the sign.

evidence.quote: The first of located just outside of...Hyrule Castle Town, head south from...the gate and go down past the sign.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe is located west of Hyrule Castle Town a bit away from the stream.

evidence.quote: The second is located west of Hyrule...Castle Town, there is a stream, follow...along it, a bit away from it to find.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears on the north side of Lon Lon Ranch when riding past the lone tree.

evidence.quote: Head to the north side of Lon Lon Ranch...and there you will find a tree standing...alone, ride past the tree to find this.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears near Gerudo Valley where there is a fork in the path to the southeast.

evidence.quote: Down at Gerudo Valley head southeast...a little to find a fork in the path...and the Poe will appear right there.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears near Gerudo Valley north of the path fork beside a lone tree.

evidence.quote: Near Gerudo Valley again, southeast there...is a fork in the path, go north from...here to find it beside the lone tree.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears between Lon Lon Ranch and Kokiri Forest at a Y-shaped fork by a boulder.

evidence.quote: Between Lon Lon Ranch and Kokiri Forest...there is a "y" shaped path fork and a...boulder there as well, it's at the rock.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears in a small patch of grass beside a lone green tree south of the boulder fork.

evidence.quote: South of the previous one you will find...a small patch of grass beside a lone...green tree, it appears in the grass.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe is found among the yellow trees or further west near the lone green tree.

evidence.quote: Just beside the previous one, in among...the yellow trees or perhaps further...west, you'll find this Big Poe.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears near Kakariko Village between the tree in front of the stairs and the cliff above.

evidence.quote: Up near Kakariko Village, between the...tree in front of the stairs and the cliff...above the next Poe will appear for you.

subject: Big Poe
text: A Big Poe appears east of Lon Lon Ranch at the angle of a boomerang-shaped stone wall.

evidence.quote: East of Lon Lon ranch there is a...boomerang shaped stone wall, where the...wall angles, that is where the Poe is.
